description: Defines classes and structures for HPACK header compression tables used in HTTP/2, including static and dynamic tables, header entries, and related operations.

classes.name: HpackStringPair
classes.description: Represents a header name-value pair with methods to compute size and output debug string.

classes.name: HpackDecoderStaticTable
classes.description: Provides access to the static HPACK header table, allowing lookup by index.

classes.name: HpackDecoderDynamicTable
classes.description: Manages the dynamic HPACK header table, supporting insertion, size updates, and eviction.

classes.name: HpackDecoderTables
classes.description: Encapsulates static and dynamic tables, providing methods for size updates, insertion, and lookup.

methods.name: HpackStringPair
methods.description: Constructor for header pair, destructor, size calculation, and debug string output.

methods.name: HpackDecoderStaticTable
methods.description: Constructors for static table, lookup method.

methods.name: HpackDecoderDynamicTable
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, size update, insert, lookup, and eviction methods.

methods.name: HpackDecoderTables
methods.description: Constructor, destructor, size update, insert, and lookup methods for combined static and dynamic tables.
